produkt.takskyddet.title: Roof Cover for Travel Trailers & Motorhomes 18–44 ft (5.5–13.5 m)
produkt.takskyddet.body_html: Nine lengths, 18 to 44 ft (5.5 to 13.5 m), all 10 ft (3 m) wide — it covers the roof surface and keeps rainwater away from roof hatches and seams through the winter.
metafalt.takskyddet.opf.problem_rubrik: The rain sits right at the roof hatch
metafalt.takskyddet.opf.problem_text: Your travel trailer or motorhome sits outside all winter. Rainwater collects around the roof hatches and seams, and no one climbs up to check until spring — that's when the moisture check tells you whether the seals held.
metafalt.takskyddet.opf.losning_text: CaraShell covers the roof surface, with the edge hanging 30–40 cm (12–16 in) down over the sides, so rainwater doesn't sit at the roof hatches. Woven webbing straps with plastic hooks latch under the edge of the body and stay put in wind. One person can put it on alone.

produkt.termoskyddet.title: Windshield Thermal Cover for Motorhome 211 × 171 cm (83 × 67 in)
produkt.termoskyddet.body_html: An exterior thermal cover, 211 × 171 cm (83 × 67 in), that keeps the cold and sun off the windshield and side windows and blacks out the cab when you sleep in the vehicle.
metafalt.termoskyddet.opf.problem_rubrik: The fog sits between the curtain and the glass
metafalt.termoskyddet.opf.problem_text: Overnight moisture settles on the inside of the windshield, and a curtain just traps it between the glass and the fabric. Then the morning sun heats the cab to 86 °F (30 °C) before breakfast is ready, and at a rest area, everyone walking by can see straight in.
metafalt.termoskyddet.opf.losning_rubrik: CaraShell sits on the outside of the windshield
metafalt.termoskyddet.opf.losning_text: The cover straps on over the outside of the windshield and both side windows, so the glass never gets cold on the inside. At the same time, it blacks out the whole cab: no one sees in, and the morning sun won't wake you at four a.m. Two minutes of work on the outside instead of fog to wipe away every day.
metafalt.termoskyddet.opf.benefits: ["No fog to wipe away in the morning","A cooler cab before breakfast is ready","No one can see in at the rest area","Sleep undisturbed — the morning sun won't wake you at four a.m."]
